summary: Tested Plantillas de Fusión and the 'Documentos de la Certificación' tab, backend and UI. Backend 12/12 pytest passed. Frontend: every requested flow passed. Type picker works. The Fusión dialog has a title field, no Asunto, and a required body; empty title and empty body each show an error toast. Variables were inserted into the body. The card shows the 'Plantilla de Fusión' badge and no 'Asunto:' line, and editing keeps the subject hidden. Fusión and Comunicación dialogs have the same 31 variables, including the group 'Empresa Integradora y Certificación'. Comunicación without Asunto shows the error toast; with Asunto it saves with the 'Comunicación' badge. Fusión templates are left out of the EntityEmailDialog and MassCommunicationDialog dropdowns. The cert-docs tab shows 'Carpeta de Anexos inicializada' with no errors. Audit_trails recorded CREATE, UPDATE and DELETE for email_templates. All TEST_ templates were deleted.

minor.issue: Does not reject FUSION templates on the server; only the frontend filters them out. A direct API call could email a Fusión template.

A GET has side effects: it creates a folder on disk and a DB record. The path is saved the first time and never recomputed, so if the app is later linked to an empresa, the stored path stays 'sin_empresa'. Only get_current_user is checked, with no integradores permission check.

issues: The 'Variables disponibles' hint at the top does not list the new variables (empresa_integradora, rif_integrador, ...). It is now out of date compared with the panel.
In the Fusión dialog, the variable panel's help text says '(o en el asunto si es el último campo editado)', but Fusión has no Asunto field.
The tab is still called 'Plantillas de Correo' even though it now holds non-email Fusión templates.
The edit and delete icon buttons on template cards have no data-testid.

action_items: Optional: reject tipo_plantilla FUSION in _mass_dispatch and in the integrator send-email endpoint.
Optional: update variablesHint and the Fusión help text; add data-testid to the card edit and delete buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: _validate_template now requires a name for every context (not only INTEGRADORES). Check that no older flow saves templates with an empty name.
The cert-docs folder path is saved once; it is not recomputed when the app's empresa changes.
seed_data_creation: None. The TEST_ templates made by pytest and the UI were deleted by id.
